title: RDP keyboard stops responding while mouse input still works
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
Observed with portable x64 build `1.84.0+7a43a3cf29` (local build 3762): an established RDP session accepted mouse movement and clicks, but typed text did not appear. The trigger and affected remote applications are not yet established.

The affected session logged a successful login, zero automatic reconnections and zero recorded transport outage before normal application closure. No focus/input telemetry was available, so these observations do not establish the cause.
